entryKey.description: The catalog entry the marked critique is about

imageSha256.description: The hash of the picture the marked critique judged, so a mark about an earlier picture is shown as that

critic.description: The critic whose opinion is marked

finding.description: The `id` of the marked finding. Absent: the critique as a whole

decision.description: Open vocabulary; this release understands `accept` (the opinion is right) and `dismiss` (it is not). Anything else is shown as written and counts as neither

reviewer.description: Who marked it: a name the reviewer chose, never an account

layer.description: The layer of the critique that was marked, for tracing
